name: Emirati Beef Machboos

components.name: Beef Machboos

ingredients.name: Water or stock (for simmering the beef)
Basmati rice (2 cups), soaked 30 min and drained

steps: Soak basmati rice in cool water about 30 minutes, drain and set aside.
Sear beef cubes in a heavy pot with a little oil, bezar, turmeric, chilli and garlic-ginger paste until coloured. Add water and simmer until beef is tender; reserve the cooking liquid.
In another heavy pan brown sliced onions. Reserve a portion for topping; add chopped tomatoes and the whole spices to the rest.
Add beef and pierced dried loomi to the onions, then stir in drained rice and chickpeas.
Measure the reserved stock and supplement with water according to rice-package absorption guidance; pour over rice and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly, reduce to very low heat and steam 15–20 minutes. Finish with saffron, ghee and reserved onion.
Lift and fluff rice rather than stirring aggressively. Divide beef and rice across six containers.

Freezer: Cooked machboos can be frozen in shallow portions quickly after cooking.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
